Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 1233 PM EST Mon Nov 16 2026
 

- Cloudy skies this morning will clear by this afternoon.

- Dry weather expected area-wide Monday through Thursday with 
temperatures above normal.

&&

.AVIATION...

Drier air arriving on modest southwest wind allows remaining stratus 
to vacate the region early this afternoon. Mainly SCT coverage of 
boundary layer cloud will persist through the rest of afternoon with 
pockets of brief BKN MVFR possible the next few hours. High pressure 
stalled over the upper Ohio Valley maintains dry and stable 
conditions with prevailing southwest wind aob 10 kt through tonight 
into Tuesday. High cloud passes overhead early tonight, then 
clearing skies become favored early Tuesday morning. This may allow 
for pockets of ground fog around sunrise, but predominant signal in 
model guidance is VFR so will hold off on including BR/FG in the 
TAFs.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...
